start.text: (Ravi, in a clean lab coat over the green lanyard. Thinner. Clear-eyed, for the first time since you met him.) You came. Sit. (He doesn't sit.)

told.text: It was me. The tray, the glove. Appa called and I answered, and I didn't seal it. Meera found me in the ward after the corridor. She said: you know what you did. Help me undo it.

meera.text: (Through the lab glass, a woman in a white coat bends over a bench. She doesn't look up.) She wanted it to heal people. It still might, she says. Not the ones who've turned.

ask.text: Her override. Every door under HIVR. (Then, quieter:) Tell Appa I picked up.

after.text: Go before they change the guard.
